info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector SuggestTagsAndRegionsApi API
Microsoft Azure Suggest Tags And Regions For An Array Batch Of Untagged Images Returns Empty Array If No Tags Are Found

params.name: iterationId
params.description: IterationId to use for tag and region suggestion.

params.name: imageIds
params.description: Array of image ids tag suggestion are needed for. Use GetUntaggedImages API to get imageIds.

items.docs:
This API will get suggested tags and regions for an array/batch of untagged images along with confidences for the tags. It returns an empty array if no tags are found.
There is a limit of 64 images in the batch.
